legPress.name: Leg press
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad, feet hip-width in the middle of the platform.
Lower the platform for 2 s until knees approach your chest without lifting your hips.
Press through your whole foot to almost straight knees without locking out.

dumbbellBenchPress.name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on the bench, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted.
Lower the dumbbells for 2 s to chest level, elbows around 45°.
Press up and slightly in without clashing the dumbbells.

wideGripLatPulldown.name: Wide-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and lock thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Return under control to a full stretch.

romanianDeadlift.name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand tall holding the bar, knees slightly bent.
Push hips back and slide the bar down your thighs with a neutral back.
When hamstrings stretch, drive hips forward. Never to failure.

sideLateralRaise.name: Side lateral raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, elbows soft.
Raise arms out to shoulder height without swinging.
Lower slowly for 2 s.

tricepsPushdown.name: Triceps pushdown (rope)
instructions: Grab the rope, elbows pinned to your sides.
Extend down and spread the rope ends at the bottom.
Return under control without moving the elbows.

cableCrunch.name: Cable crunch
instructions: Kneel facing the cable holding the rope by your head.
Crunch your torso toward your knees, hips stay still.
Return slowly to a stretch.

trapBarDeadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
instructions: Stand in the middle of the trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip the handles, chest up, neutral back.
Push the floor away to stand up, lower under control. Never to failure.

chestSupportedDumbbellRow.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips, squeezing shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

seatedDumbbellShoulderPress.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit against an upright back pad, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead without arching your lower back.
Lower for 2 s to shoulder height.

lyingLegCurl.name: Lying leg curl
instructions: Lie on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Curl heels toward glutes keeping hips down.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.

machineChestPress.name: Machine chest press
instructions: Set the seat so handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward without locking elbows.
Return under control to a chest stretch.

inclineDumbbellCurl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
instructions: Sit on a 45–60° bench, arms hanging.
Curl without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

facePull.name: Face pull
instructions: Cable at face height, overhand grip on the rope.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope, elbows high.
Pause briefly and return under control.

bulgarianSplitSquat.name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Rear foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel. Do all sets per leg.

inclineDumbbellPress.name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Bench at 30°, shoulder blades pinched.
Lower dumbbells for 2 s toward the upper chest.
Press up without locking elbows.

neutralGripPulldown.name: Neutral-grip pulldown
instructions: Grab a V-handle or parallel handles.
Pull to your upper chest, elbows close to the body.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

legExtension.name: Leg extension
instructions: Adjust the back pad so knees align with the machine pivot.
Extend legs fully and pause briefly.
Lower slowly for 2 s.

cableCrossover.name: Cable crossover / pec deck
instructions: Stand between the cables, elbows slightly bent.
Bring hands together in front of your chest in an arc.
Return slowly to a chest stretch.

cableLateralRaise.name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Low cable, grab the handle with the opposite hand.
Raise the arm out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

standingCalfRaise.name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Balls of your feet on the edge, heels free.
Lower heels to a full stretch and hold 1 s.
Rise up as high as possible.

hangingKneeRaise.name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from the bar with active shoulders.
Raise knees toward your chest, curling the pelvis.
Lower slowly without swinging.

hackSquat.name: Hack squat
instructions: Back against the pad, feet shoulder-width.
Lower under control as deep as your knees allow.
Press through your whole foot.

gobletSquat.name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit down between your knees, chest up.
Stand up through your whole foot.

assistedPullUp.name: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Knees on the machine pad or feet in a band.
Pull your chin over the bar, driving elbows down.
Lower slowly to full extension.

hipThrust.name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, bar across your hips.
Raise hips until your body is in line, squeeze glutes.
Lower under control.

dumbbellDeadlift.name: Dumbbell deadlift
instructions: Dumbbells in front of thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Return by driving the hips, back neutral.

walkingLunge.name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel and step through with the other leg.
Keep the torso upright.

narrowStanceLegPress.name: Narrow-stance leg press
instructions: Feet narrower than hips, lower on the platform.
Lower the platform under control.
Press without locking the knees.

plank.name: Plank
instructions: Support yourself on forearms and toes.
Body in a straight line, brace abs and glutes.
Hold for the set time and breathe steadily.

pullUp.name: Pull-up
instructions: Grab the bar overhand, slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, driving elbows down.
Lower under control to full extension. Add weight once 10 reps feel easy.

latPulldown.name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar shoulder-width or slightly wider, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Return slowly to a full back stretch.

seatedCableRow.name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Row the handle to your stomach, squeezing shoulder blades.
Return under control without swinging your torso.

overheadCableTricepsExtension.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
instructions: Face away from the cable holding the rope behind your head.
Extend forward and up, elbows stay by your head.
Return slowly to a full triceps stretch.

seatedLegCurl.name: Seated leg curl
instructions: Set the machine so knees line up with the pivot, pad above heels.
Curl your heels under the seat.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.

seatedCalfRaise.name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine, pad on thighs, balls of feet on the platform.
Lower heels to a full stretch and hold 1 s.
Raise your heels as high as possible.

hangingLegRaise.name: Hanging leg raise
instructions: Hang from the bar with active shoulders and a still body.
Raise your legs toward your chest, curling the pelvis.
Lower slowly without swinging.
